question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Insipid
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e**. 'Tasty'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Insipid"** refers to something lacking flavor, tasteless, or uninteresting (स्वादहीन या नीरस).
 
• **"Tasty" **(Option 3) signifies something that has a good flavor or taste, serving as an appropriate antonym (स्वादिष्ट).

Therefore, the** correct answer **is-** 'Tasty'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Explicit" **(Option 1) refers to something clearly stated or shown (स्पष्ट), not a suitable antonym for "Insipid".
 
• **"Opaque"** (Option 2) represents something not transparent (अपारदर्शी), not an antonym of "Insipid".
 
• **"Immense"** (Option 4) refers to extremely large or great (अत्यधिक), which is unrelated to the concept of "Insipid".
